svg.title: policies-lan — Loom control center
svg.text: A policy defines access to one service. Assign the same policy to any devices that need these rules.
One service can have several policies.
Each device chooses one per service.

g.text: Deny keeps the policy assigned but blocks access to this service.
Select at least one node. Selection order does not define a route.
All current and future eligible nodes.
No entry nodes = no LAN path. No transit nodes may still allow one hop to the gateway.
Entry: control-a · Transit: unrestricted · LAN gateway: relay-west
The device chooses a permitted path to 198.51.100.0/24. The LAN gateway stays fixed.
No devices assigned. Select office-lan from a device's access policies.
Saving updates every reference. To change one device, assign another policy or save a copy.
Removes its access. Devices do not switch to another policy automatically.
